lines.text: Many learners say: I am too happy to see you.
Better: I am so happy to see you.
Too sounds like too much. Use so.
So! I am so happy to see you.

native.tip: too は「〜すぎる」で悪い意味になりがち。うれしいときは so を使います。
native.caption: “I am too happy to see you.”と言っていませんか？😅 「とても」を too に訳してしまいがちです。“I am so happy to see you.” が自然な言い方です。Carlosの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“so”。同じ形で自分の文を1つ書いてみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: Too means too much. Use so for very.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I am too happy to see you.” 😅 Too often sounds like a problem. The natural way is “I am so happy to see you.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
